comment: E2E: code-based comparison via gsheets_run_python with a polymorphic binding set — one INLINE data binding (a table the model 'extracted from an image') + one SHEET binding. pandas computes the diff deterministically. Replace <YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID> and <TAB_NAME>; run per the gsheets E2E runbook. Verifies Part A (inline + sheet bindings + comparison).

test_payload.prompt:
I extracted this nutritional table from an IMAGE (label -> value):
[{"label": "Calorías (kcal)", "value": 116}, {"label": "Carbohidratos totales", "value": "5 g"}]

Compare it against tab '<TAB_NAME>' of spreadsheet_id (copy EXACTLY): <YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID> (a label->value table, range 'A2:B').

Call gsheets_run_python ONCE with TWO bindings: (1) INLINE {"var":"img","data":[{"label":"Calorías (kcal)","value":116},{"label":"Carbohidratos totales","value":"5 g"}]} ; (2) SHEET {"var":"sheet","spreadsheet_id":"<YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID>","sheet":"<TAB_NAME>","range":"A2:B"}. Code: scols=_gsheets_loaded_columns['sheet']; slab,sval=scols[0],scols[1]; dsheet={str(r[slab]):str(r[sval]) for r in sheet}; dimg={str(r['label']):str(r['value']) for r in img}; diffs=[{'label':k,'image':dimg[k],'sheet':dsheet.get(k)} for k in dimg if str(dimg[k])!=str(dsheet.get(k))]; output={'differences':diffs,'img_rows':len(img),'sheet_rows':len(sheet)}. Report the differences in plain language.

config.system_message: You compare a table extracted from an image against a Google Sheet using gsheets_run_python (pandas) — pass the image table as an INLINE data binding and the sheet as a sheet binding. Follow the provided code pattern verbatim.
